data:
{{Top}}
{{Youmay|the process of cloning|the [[Clones (song)|song]] from ''[[Star Wars: Republic Commando]]''|linebreak=1}}
{{Quote|Clones can think creatively. You will find that they are immensely superior to droids.|[[Lama Su/Legends|Lama Su]]|<ref name="SWEII">{{Film|II}}</ref>}}
[[File:Kamino_Facility.jpg|thumb|300px|A batch of clone troopers during the early stages of their development on Kamino]]
'''Cloning''' was the process of creating a genetically identical or—purposefully and specifically—modified copy of an [[Clone template/Legends|original organism]]. It was one of the key factors that facilitated the [[Clone Wars/Legends|end]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Declaration of a New Order|dawn]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in its place. Through the science of cloning, a vast [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone army]] was created on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] for the purpose of serving the Republic. Programmed with absolute loyalty to [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], leader of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] and secretly the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Sidious, the clones proved to be instrumental in his [[Order 66/Legends|rise]] to the position of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]]. The military applications of cloning were further exploited by the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]] through the creation of countless more [[Clone stormtrooper|clone soldiers]], all used mainly to spread and enforce Imperial hegemony throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==Overview==
{{Quote|With the same genetic structure plus a flash-learning pattern taken directly from the template, a clone should theoretically be completely identical to the original person. But despite that, they're never exactly the same. Maybe some of the mental subtleties get blurred over in transition, or maybe there's something else unique inside us that a flash-learning reader isn't able to pick up.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], to [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]]|<ref name="VotF">''[[Vision of the Future]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Starkiller_clones.png|thumb|left|250px|A room of tanks containing [[Aberrant clone|clones]] of [[Galen Marek]]]]
In order to create a clone, samples of genetic code had to be drawn from a subject's cells, duplicated and implanted into donor cells. These donor cells would then grow, divide and, eventually [[Embryo|gestate]] in artificial wombs, filled with nutrients and organic catalysts. Altering the nutrients and catalyst solutions that the cells received could influence the physical attributes and maturation rates of the resulting clone. The most aggressive mixtures of nutrients and catalyst solutions produced fully formed adult clones in several weeks, but forced growth acceleration often led to [[Clone madness|mental instability]] in the clone. Some [[Clone Master/Legends|cloners]], however, [[Ysalamiri/Legends|discovered methods to avoid this phenomenon]].<ref name="DES">''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> The genetic material donor was generally referred to as a [[Clone template/Legends|prime clone]].<ref name="Republic50">[[Republic 50|''Republic'' 50]]</ref> Using the subject's template, it was possible through many different techniques to create exact physical replicas. This process was not only capable of producing a single copy, but also multiple versions of the original subject.<ref name="SWEII" /> Furthermore, genetic engineering could further modify the clone to augment or subdue specific traits.<ref name="Hard Contact">''[[Republic Commando: Hard Contact]]''</ref>

[[File:99-SWE.png|thumb|right|220px|[[99/Legends|99]], a deformed clone of Jango Fett]]
Although mass cloning was considered useful because of its military applications,<ref name="Darth Plagueis">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> individual clones generally lacked the personality of the original.<ref name="VotF" /> As such, they often needed to be educated during the process of their development. The original [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] that were produced over the course of a decade on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] were educated at a more gradual pace<ref name="SWEII" /> than their [[Spaarti cloning cylinder|Spaarti]]-engineered counterparts. Clones who fully matured in just a year's time received an extremely rushed form of education through [[flash pumping]].<ref name="EGtW:AC7">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-7-the-grand-army-of-the-republic|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 7 — The Grand Army of the Republic}}</ref><ref name="Order 66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref> The fastest developed clones—grown in the span of a few weeks—were trained through [[Memory flash|memory imprints]], taken from the original donor and downloaded into the copied subjects. This essentially enabled a clone to learn all of its template's skills, but also carried with them emotional imprints, and thus the risk of mental instability as well.<ref name="TFUII">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]''</ref> Such mental instability had plagued almost all early cloning experiments, with the severity of the symptoms scaling inversely to the length of the growth period. According to [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], a pre–Clone Wars scientific paper discussing cloning concluded that clones grown to maturity in less than a year would have been entirely unable to survive outside a fully controlled environment.<ref name="TLC">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref>

Because growth environment was a highly influential factor, a clone could develop characteristics and identities distinct from its donor's, even if it was a genetically identical copy.<ref name="DES" /> A longstanding debate over cloning and flash memory was whether a clone retained the thoughts and memories of its progenitor. Some believed that clones were identical to the original in every way, while others argued that clones were unique through their individual experiences.<ref name="VotF" />

Some cultures fully embraced the possibilities of cloning, most notably the [[Khommite/Legends|people]] of [[Khomm/Legends|Khomm]], who abandoned natural reproduction in favor of becoming a clone society.<ref name="TFUIIn">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'' novelization]]</ref> Khommite clones from the [[Dorsk]] lineage were active in the [[New Jedi Order]].<ref name="Darksaber">[[Darksaber (novel)|''Darksaber'']]</ref>

Cloning was not limited to creating whole copies of an individual; in [[Medcenter/Legends|medcenter]] prosthetics units, patients could provide samples of their own genetic material in order to grow clone replacements for organs, [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], muscles, and skin. The process could take up to three [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]], but a patient had a better chance of their body not rejecting a cloned replacement that was taken from their own genetics.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

==History==
===Early development===
{{Quote|As practically everyone knows, cloning is the science of taking a cell from a living organism, duplicating the genetic code, and growing the cell into an exact duplicate of the cell donor.|[[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], a gatekeeper of the [[Telos Holocron]]|<ref name="JediVsSith">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>}}
[[File:Youngclonestraining.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Young clones of Jango Fett being educated in the Tipoca City Military Complex]]
The art of cloning technology was developed by a number of civilizations in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Noted species that possessed the technology included the inhabitants of the worlds of Khomm, [[Lur]], [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]], [[Columus/Legends|Columus]], and [[Arkania/Legends|Arkania]]. One of the more infamous species to possess a great deal of knowledge of cloning were the inhabitants of Kamino, who were renowned for their skill in the field.<ref name="SWEII" /> The [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoans]] later taught their skill in cloning to the [[Kallidahin/Legends|inhabitants]] of [[Polis Massa/Legends|Polis Massa]], who used it to help develop an advanced medical and genetic [[Polis Massa Research Base|research station]] on their homeworld.<ref name="tnegtas">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> The insectoid [[Verpine/Legends|Verpines]] of the [[Roche asteroid field]] also made use of cloning to propagate their worker castes.<ref name="GG4">''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]''</ref>

One of the largest cloning operations was the creation of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], an immense [[Army/Legends|army]] of clone soldiers—all based on the [[DNA/Legends|genetic template]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]—created by Kaminoan [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] as part of an initially clandestine program to seemingly reestablish a [[Republic Military/Legends|pan-galactic military force]] for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="SWEII" /> It was in truth part of a complex and masterfully executed deception conceived by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]<ref name="TCW|The Lost One">{{TCW|The Lost One}}</ref> that would ultimately furnish them with the means to destroy the Republic<ref name="SWEIII">{{Film|III}}</ref> and control the galaxy.<ref name="Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope">{{Film|IV}}</ref>

In a vast facility maintained within [[Tipoca City/Legends|Tipoca City]], clones were grown and trained in the [[Kamino cloning chamber|cloning chambers]] at the city's [[Clone military education complex|military complex]].<ref name="SWEII" /> The first attempt to replicate Jango Fett resulted in twelve prototype clones, known as the [[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando|''Null''-class Advanced Recon Commandos]], and were the subject of the Kaminoans' attempts to enhance Fett's genome. While the clones would possess photographic memory and perfect recall, and substantially bulkier frames as adults, half of the twelve did not survive the gestation period, and the six who did were deemed uncontrollable by their creators. But at the behest of ''[[Cuy'val Dar]]'' [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] [[Kal Skirata]], the clones were ultimately spared from being reconditioned—a fate which, in this case, would mean death. Disappointed by their first attempt to modify Fett's genetic code, the Kaminoans proceeded with the creation of the [[Alpha-class Advanced Recon Commando|''Alpha'' generation]], a new batch of [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC troopers]] personally trained by Fett.<ref name="Republic Commando: Triple Zero">''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]''</ref> In addition, the Kaminoans took DNA samples from [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Falon Grey]], which they used to create twin [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] clones called [[X1]] and [[X2]].<ref name="SWBFES">''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron]]''</ref>

[[File:Clonestraining.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Adult clones eating a meal in the Tipoca City Military Complex]]
The standard troopers were genetically altered to be more docile and susceptible to obeying orders than their genetic template, supplemented by rigorous behavior modifications to instill absolute loyalty to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. A surgically implanted [[Inhibitor chip/Legends|Inhibitor chip]] was officially said to be a further safeguard against potential mental instability.<ref name="TCW|Conspiracy">{{TCW|Conspiracy}}</ref> In reality the chip was able to force the clone to follow set [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|contingency orders]] without question. As part of the [[Sith]] master plan, [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] was invoked to [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|destroy the Jedi]].<ref name="TCW|The Unknown">{{TCW|The Unknown}}</ref>

In order to grow fully matured clones in half of the time it takes ordinary Humans, the Kaminoans modified the clones by implementing age acceleration into their development, thus allowing the clones to reach adulthood in ten years instead of two decades. Although the exact rate at which clones aged is unknown, it appears to be nearly twice as fast a natural-born Human and it is theorized that this rate increased as clones grew older—especially under stress, thus leading to a dramatic shortening of the clones' life expectancy.<ref name="True Colors">''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]''</ref> Despite these modifications, the clone troopers could still think and act creatively and possessed a level of individuality that their Kaminoan creators did not anticipate.

By the second year of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] had established a secondary cloning facility in secret on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]], [[Centax-2/Legends|Centax-2]].<ref name="True Colors" /> Under the supervision of [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]] [[Clone Master/Legends|Clone Masters]], the facility was operated by the company [[Arkanian Microtechnologies]] and used Spaarti cloning cylinders to produce fully matured clones within a year. Hence, the clones from Kamino were supplemented by billions of clones that were roughly a year old and instructed through flash pumping.<ref name="EGtW:AC7" /><ref name="True Colors" /><ref name="Order 66" /> But with only a year to grow the clones and prepare them for war, the fighting ability of Spaarti-grown clones was noticeably lower than their counterparts from Kamino. Thus, the overall result of Spaarti technology led to clones with underdeveloped combat and marksmanship skills, including a heavily diminished sense of individuality and self-preservation.

Aside from Jango Fett's considerable price to become the clone template, Fett also requested an unaltered clone for himself. Jango regarded the clone as his son and legacy, thus naming him [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]. Per Jango's terms, Boba's genetic structure was not altered with age acceleration or increased docility programming, essentially making him an exact physical duplicate of his father. Despite receiving none of the modifications that his clone "brothers" possessed, Boba would still experience the degradation of his DNA later in life due to the fact that he was a clone. During the Clone Wars, [[Zeltron/Legends|Zeltron]] bounty hunter [[Vianna D'Pow]] followed Jango's example and commissioned the Kaminoans to create a single clone of herself.<ref name="OOAK">{{CWACite|8|One of a Kind (comic story)}}</ref>

[[File:SWREP74-FC.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Bok and the Morgukai Shadow Army]]
Although the Clone Army was evidently a significant advantage to the Republic, which had lacked a proper military force for over a millennium, it was also recognized that clone soldiers could be one of the greatest threats to the Republic if they were not created strictly under Republic supervision. Hence, the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] issued [[Decree E49D139.41]] near the end of the Clone Wars, thus confining all military-purpose cloning to specifically licensed Republic facilities and banning all non-military cloning of sentients with the exception of the medical cloning on Khomm, Lur, Columus, and Arkania, although even they required a license and a case-by-case evaluation. The ban also prohibited the sale of cloning equipment, the hiring of cloning or genetic engineers with the intention of cloning, and the purchase of any cloned sentients.<ref name="True Colors" />

The Separatists also attempted to create their own army of clone soldiers to counter the Grand Army of the Republic, to which they selected the [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] [[Morgukai]] known as [[Bok]] as a clone template. Thus, the [[Morgukai Shadow Army]] was created on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] world of [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]], presumably grown from Spaarti cylinders, trained by [[Anzat (species)|Anzati]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]], and programmed with unconditional loyalty to the Confederacy of Independent Systems. They would never make it off-planet, however, as the facility was destroyed following the [[Siege of Saleucami/Legends|Siege of Saleucami]].<ref name="Star Wars: Republic: Siege of Saleucami">''[[Star Wars: Republic: Siege of Saleucami]]''</ref>

Only towards the end of the Clone Wars did the Jedi Order learn that the Sith had been involved in the cloning program from its inception, although they knew not to what purpose.<ref name="TCW|The Lost One" /> They kept this knowledge a secret from the Senate, as they thought it would destabilize the Republic and undermine the war effort. Instead, they resolved to take the only path they could see available, which was to play the game they now knew to have been orchestrated by the Sith, and end the war as quickly as possible.<ref name="TCW|The Lost One" /> When Palpatine issued Order 66, the [[Inhibitor chip/Legends|inhibitor chip]] implanted in every clone ensured it would be carried out, and the Jedi were exterminated. This gave [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] a free hand to reorder the Republic into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Thus the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|clone army]] meant to protect the Republic became the harbinger of its fall.

[[File:FrommGangMember.jpg|thumb|One of many [[Annoo-dat Blue]] clones employed by [[Sise Fromm]] and [[Fromm Gang|his gang]]]]Around this time, the aging underworld kingpin [[Sise Fromm]] employed a small army of clones as muscle for [[Sise Fromm's stronghold|his stronghold]] on [[Annoo (Gelefil)|Annoo]].<ref name="Escape Into Terror">{{DroidsCite|Escape Into Terror}}</ref><ref name="The Trigon Unleashed">{{DroidsCite|The Trigon Unleashed}}</ref>

In the early days of the Empire, the bounty hunter Boba Fett captured the much-diminished Fromm leadership and turned them over to [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure|Jabba the Hutt]].<ref name="A Race to the Finish">{{DroidsCite|A Race to the Finish}}</ref> The elder Fromm cut a deal with Jabba to save his life, pledging control his army of Annoo-dat clones to Jabba's struggle against the encroaching Mandalorian Death Watch warriors within his territory, in addition to a generous portion of the gang's income.<ref name="TDRA2">{{SW|url=news/the-droids-re-animated-part-2|series=The Droids Re-Animated|text=Part 2|nolive=1}}</ref>

===Reign of the Empire===
{{Quote|What can you teach a clone in a few months that a man takes a lifetime to learn?|[[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]|<ref name="2edgedsword">{{InsiderCite|85|A Two-Edged Sword}}</ref>}}
[[File:SWTV6-FC.jpg|thumb|right|180px|The science of cloning produced roughly half of the Empire's stormtroopers.]]
With the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], there were strict laws placed on cloning technology to prevent anti-Imperial factions from breeding their own army of clones, which then led to the Empire's attempts at seizing the technology from other civilizations. This included an attempt to confiscate agricultural and cloning technology from the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorians]] through military force.<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Later, [[Momaw Nadon/Legends|Momaw Nadon]] used his knowledge of cloning to create a clone of Captain [[Alima]] after the Imperial Prefect was killed. Nadon decided to obey the Ithorian [[Law of Life]], and thus he created a clone replica of the Imperial officer.<ref name="TST:THT">{{StoryCite|story=The Sand Tender: The Hammerhead's Tale|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref>

Among the reformations that transformed the Republic into the Empire, the former Grand Army of the Republic was reorganized into the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]]. The remaining clone troopers that survived the Clone Wars were rechristened as [[Stormtrooper/Legends|Imperial stormtroopers]].<ref name="HoloNet News">{{InsiderCite|84|Republic HoloNet News Special Inaugural Edition 16:5:241}}</ref> Despite the ban on cloning, the Empire continued to utilize [[Clone stormtrooper|clone soldiers]] in secret. With the exception of [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officers]] and [[GeNode]] clones,<ref name="Pax Empirica">{{StoryCite|story=Pax Empirica—The Wookiee Annihilation|book=Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide}}</ref> the Stormtrooper Corps was almost fully composed of clones based on the genetic template of Jango Fett.<ref name="BattlefrontII">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref>

The [[Kamino uprising|Clone Rebellion]] of Kamino in [[12 BBY/Legends|12 BBY]] brought an end to the Fett clones' proud dominion over the Stormtrooper Corps. Though they succeeded in suppressing the revolt by storming Tipoca City and annihilating an [[Anti-trooper|army of Fett clones]] designed to fight against the Empire, Emperor Palpatine lost confidence in an army cloned entirely from one man. As a result, future generations of stormtroopers were cloned from a variety of templates. Not long afterward, the ranks were opened up to non-clone Humans who served as enlisted troopers alongside the clones.<ref name="BattlefrontII" /> The Empire's dependency on cloning also led to the creation of [[Cuis clone|experimental soldiers]] based on the Force-sensitive template of [[Sa Cuis]], an [[Emperor's Hand/Legends|Emperor's Hand]].<ref name="2edgedsword" /> Even though the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] was allowed to remain pure, the Fett clones resented their sudden status as a minority within the army that they once filled as a whole.<ref name="BattlefrontII" />

Even before the formation of the Empire, the Kaminoan format for cloning had been virtually supplanted by Spaarti technology. In the [[19 BBY/Legends|final year]] of the Clone Wars, Palpatine revealed the existence of another clone army that was different from the original in two ways—the new clones were engineered on Coruscant's moon Centax-2 instead of Kamino, and they grew to adulthood in one year instead of ten years.<ref name="Order 66" /> Decades later when Palpatine recorded his legacy into the [[Telos Holocron]], he admitted his preference for the Spaarti cloning process. Though he did admire the achievements made by the Kaminoan cloners, the accelerated growth rate of Kaminoan-engineered clones was too slow in Palpatine's opinion.<ref name="JediVsSith" /> Even though the Spaarti clones were far less intelligent and combat effective than the clones bred on Kamino, Palpatine was unconcerned with the apparent disadvantages. The Kaminoan clone army had to meet the best standards in order to fulfill their ultimate mission in exterminating the Jedi Order; the Spaarti clones were meant to bolster the Grand Army's depleted ranks so that the Emperor would have a sufficient number of soldiers to enforce his reign the first years of the Empire.<ref name="Order 66" />

[[File:Kaminouprising.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A stormtrooper and an anti-trooper, both clones of Jango Fett, fighting each other on Kamino]]
At some point during the early phase of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Imperial scientists tried to improve on the Kaminoan method by conducting an experiment to create clones that grew into adulthood in under one year. Through the "''accelerated cloning process''," clones could be engineered to reach maturity in a mere few weeks while their minds were developed through memory flashes based on imprints of a genetic donor's brain patterns. But the procedure was consistently undermined by several flaws that resulted in highly unstable subjects.<ref name="TFUIIc">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II (graphic novel)|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II'' graphic novel]]</ref>

Aside from the physical deformities, the accelerated clones were compromised by abnormalities in their brain development. According to the projections of Imperial scientists, all of the accelerated clones were doomed to suffer from mental instability not long after their creation. Some of the clones would remain stable enough to serve as infantry for a year before succumbing to insanity while others would never make it past their basic training. In order to correct the flaws within the accelerated cloning process, many batches of unstable clones had to be created before the system could be perfected.<ref name="TFUIIc" />

====Cloning the secret apprentice====
{{Quote|I can hear his thoughts. I have his dreams.''"<br />"''Yes. Those that failed before you could not escape them. It was their undoing.|The Dark Apprentice and Darth Vader, lamenting the setbacks with all of Starkiller's clones|<ref name="TFUII" />}}
Following the death of [[Galen Marek]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] endeavored to recreate his former secret apprentice through cloning technology. Thus, Marek's body was brought to [[Timira City]] on Kamino to be the genetic template for a single clone that would take the original's place as Vader's Sith assassin. To avoid taking the time required to train a new apprentice all over again, Vader chose to utilize the newly developed "accelerated cloning process." Through the highly experimental procedure, the clone would be engineered to reach young adulthood in less than a month rather than a year or a decade. The imprints from Marek's brain patterns would also be used to impart the apprentice's knowledge and skills to the clone, effectively insuring that the "new Starkiller" would be just as powerful as the original prior to his death.<ref name="TFUII" />

[[File:Galen_Marek_in_Star_Wars-_The_Force_Unleashed_II.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Starkiller, Galen Marek's clone]]
But the experiment resulted in a "crash and burn" procedure due to the imperfections in the accelerated cloning process. The first wave of Marek's accelerated clones were aberrant replicas, both physically deformed and mentally deranged.<ref name="TFUIIvg-db">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'' databank</ref> The process eventually became more stable, but each version of the original Starkiller was constantly haunted by memories of a life that they never lived, thus failing to meet Vader's expectations.<ref name="TFUIIn" /> After many errors, [[Subject 1138|one clone]] endured Vader's training program long enough for the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] to hope that this version would be the final result of the entire project. But like his clone "brothers," this version was also confused by visions of a past that was not his, which Vader dismissed as a dead man's memories and a side effect of the cloning procedure. But the clone was ultimately unable to free himself from Galen Marek's memories, especially his affection for [[Juno Eclipse/Legends|Juno Eclipse]], the woman who was largely responsible for Marek's rejection of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] before his death. Before Vader could destroy his latest failure, the clone escaped from Kamino in order to find Eclipse. He was subsequently known by his template's codename ''Starkiller''.<ref name="TFUIIn" />

Around this time, however, Vader perfected the cloning process by creating a [[Dark Apprentice|clone]] that surpassed all of the other imperfect replicas that came before him.<ref name="DT">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II]]'': "Distant Thunder" cutscenes</ref> Although he was also disturbed by the same memories of Galen Marek's life and his feelings for Juno Eclipse, this clone was determined to succeed where the others had failed. As his training progressed, the clone compartmentalized Marek's memories and was able to hold them as separate from his own experiences. By freeing himself from his template's memories and having come to despise his progenitor as a "broken man" brought down by his own weaknesses, the clone was granted access to the dead body that was used to create him. The sight of the original Starkiller helped the clone realize that the cloning process had ended with him. He was the only ''perfect'' clone of Starkiller who was meant to stand at Darth Vader's side as his ''Dark Apprentice''.<ref name="TFUIIvg-db" />

[[File:VaderDarkApprenticeMarekBody-TFU2.png|thumb|left|200px|Darth Vader reveals the body of the original Starkiller to the only perfect clone of the Secret Apprentice.]]
According to [[Ni-Ke-Vanz]], a former slave who possessed intimate knowledge of cloning procedures, cloning was not the key to "immortality." Even though clones were naturally based to a very large degree on a genetic template, each clone was a new person that possessed his own identity and memories, and was ultimately a separate individual from the original. Clones that belonged to the same genetic structure were also different from each other. They were not the same people, just different versions of the same template.<ref name="TFUIIn" />

Darth Vader confirmed Ni-Ke-Vanz's assertions on cloning when he revealed some of the reasons behind the failures of various clones of Galen Marek. While Marek's clones possessed the problematic memories and emotions of the original secret apprentice, some characteristic traits were inherently more dominant than others in each clone. Some were haunted by the memory of Marek's father, [[Kento Marek]], while others were affected by the young boy that Marek had once been before his tutelage under Vader.<ref name="TFUIIn" /> Overall, it became evident that engineering a clone who possessed all of the attributes and [[The Force/Legends|Force potential]] of Starkiller was not the real problem. The greatest challenge was to create a clone who could avoid an identity crisis by holding his memory imprints as separate from his own experience.<ref name="TFUIIvg-db" />

In Starkiller's case, he became completely fixated on Juno Eclipse, but spared little to no feelings over other things such as his progenitor's father or even the Rebel Alliance. He dismissed everything else as irrelevant in comparison to his fixation on Eclipse, nor could he comprehend the idea that any clone of Vader's original apprentice could be distracted by something other than Marek's love for the woman who was the most responsible for his redemption.<ref name="TFUIIn" /> Even the Dark Apprentice was affected by Marek's feelings for Juno, only to succeed where all of his brothers failed by rising above the emotional imprints.<ref name="DT" />

====The incident on Dantooine====
[[File:Cloning_Centre.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A cloning center operating during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]]]
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], cloning technology was discovered in the [[Jedi Enclave]] on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. Similar to Spaarti cylinders in that they produced mature clones in a very short time, the cloning tanks were tended to completely by [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. The facility appeared to indiscriminately clone any being who entered it, collecting genetic material and even scanning the minds of those beings so that the clones could be implanted with memories. As a result, the clones were completely under the illusion that they were the individuals that they had been cloned from. The purpose behind this facility was not discovered. Darth Vader came to believe the technology found was what remained of research done by the ancient [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] into cloning.<ref name="Galaxy of Fear: Clones">''[[Galaxy of Fear: Clones]]''</ref>

====Immortality through cloning====
{{Quote|As one's body is consumed by the power of the dark side, the key to immortality is the growth of new bodies into which one can project one's own life essence. Unfortunately, because the clones are one step removed from the natural life process itself, they are much more vulnerable to the effects of the dark side, and age at an extremely accelerated rate. The only logical solution is to grow many more clones at the same time as backups.|Darth Sidious, a gatekeeper of the [[Telos Holocron]]|<ref name="JediVsSith" />}}
[[File:Palps_Reborn-TEA.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A young clone of Emperor Palpatine, serving as a temporary vessel for the Sith Lord's spirit]]
At some point, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] Darth Sidious sought to discover a way to extend his lifetime in the hopes of avoiding [[Death/Legends|death]]. Though his ambition ran contrary to the teachings of [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]], who emphasized the importance of the [[Order of the Sith Lords|Sith Order]] over the individual, Sidious had little intention of being succeeded by a [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] long after he had established his rule as [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|emperor]] of the Galactic Empire.<ref name="DE">''[[Star Wars: Dark Empire]]''</ref> While he originally considered Darth Vader and Galen Marek as his potential successors, Vader's injuries on Mustafar<ref name="SWEIII" /> and Starkiller's untimely death<ref name="TFUvg">''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]''</ref> strengthened Sidious' resolve to preserve his reign by avoiding his own death. Thus, he looked to cloning as a possible solution to his dilemma as early as the late phase of the Clone Wars.<ref name="Order 66" />

By [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Sidious used the assets of his alter ego, [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Chancellor]] Palpatine of the Galactic Republic, to track down a rogue Kaminoan scientist named [[Ko Sai/Legends|Ko Sai]]. He had hoped that her achievements as a cloner would yield some sort of discovery on how to extend his own life.<ref name="Order 66" /> Although the Chancellor had entrusted the Kaminoan's capture to the elite [[Clone commando/Legends|commandos]] of [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta Squad]], the clones failed to prevent Ko Sai from committing suicide, nor did they succeed at retrieving her valuable research.<ref name="True Colors" />

Darth Sidious's desire to extend his lifetime gradually developed into an obsession to live forever, causing him to develop a powerful sense of paranoia over death. Nevertheless, he finally discovered a way to cheat death, but at a great price. Through his newfound [[Force power/Legends|Force power]], [[Transfer essence|Essence Transfer]], Sidious had the power to project his [[Force ghost/Legends|spiritual consciousness]] into another body. While still alive in his original body, Sidious secretly commissioned a large batch of clones that were based on his own genetic template. The clones were kept in stasis and maintained on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Byss/Legends|Byss]] in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] of the galaxy.<ref name="DE" />

However, the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] was forced to pay a heavy price for immortality. In the Telos Holocron, he lamented on the shortcomings of cloning. Because clones were one step removed from the natural life process, they were easily susceptible to the damaging side effects of the dark side. A living being of natural birth had a difficult challenge of trying to control the dark side, but was ultimately doomed to experience the lethal consequences of being heavily immersed in the dark side's energies after a long period of time. A clone's body was almost utterly defenseless against the negative aspects of the dark side, thus subjecting the clone to rapid aging and decay.<ref name="JediVsSith" /> Although Darth Vader created clones, such as Starkiller and the Dark Apprentice, that did not share the same imperfections of the Emperor's clones (i.e. rapid accelerated aging, an extreme vulnerability to the dark side's harmful side effects),<ref name="TFUII" /> Darth Sidious was not as successful as his apprentice was in the field of cloning. Thus, he had to duplicate his body many times in order to transfer his spirit from one clone body to another as each host swiftly decayed under the unbearable pressure of the dark power that became intertwined with Sidious' own spirit.<ref name="DE" />

[[File:EmperorReborn-PTP2.jpg|thumb|250px|Sidious' clone bodies experienced rapid age acceleration due to the dark side.]]
Until the year [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], over two decades into his reign as emperor, Sidious never had the opportunity to test his experiment. But at the decisive [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of]] [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], the Emperor was betrayed and killed by his apprentice on the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]]. Though Vader was fatally wounded in the attempt, he succeeded in killing Darth Sidious, thus ending the Order of the Sith Lords.<ref name="SWEVI">{{Film|VI}}</ref> But even in his defeat, Sidious refused to accept his own death and finally tested his secret Force ability. With his mortal flesh destroyed, the Dark Lord's spirit endured the maddening experience of being disembodied. After painstaking efforts, he reached Byss, where he entered one of his clone bodies. By awakening as the young man that he once was, Sidious achieved his great desire to avoid death, even if his clone bodies were only a short-term solution.<ref name="DE" />

Because the clones could only sustain their progenitor's life force for barely a year before experiencing complete destabilization, the Kaminoan process for engineering mature clones was out of the question. The Dark Lord needed many adult versions of himself on standby in order to consistently transfer his spirit into another temporary host again and again, thus forcing him to depend completely on Spaarti technology. For six years after his first death, Sidious allowed the galaxy to believe that he was dead. In all that time, he concealed his existence on Byss, all the while constantly enduring the painful experience of dying and transferring his soul into another clone of himself.<ref name="DE" />

===Post-Endor period===
[[File:CloneThrawn.jpg|thumb|left|100px|A clone of Grand Admiral Thrawn]]
As the Galactic Empire became increasingly destabilized due to the deaths of Emperor Palpatine and Darth Vader, [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] rediscovered stockpiles of Imperial cloning technology at [[Mount Tantiss/Legends|Mount Tantiss]] on [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]]. Through the use of the facility's Spaarti cloning cylinders, Thrawn engineered an army of stormtrooper clones in less than a year. The clones served as the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] Grand Admiral's soldiers in a [[Thrawn campaign|campaign]] to reclaim the galaxy from the fledgling [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="DFR">''[[Dark Force Rising]]''</ref> In addition to creating millions of clone soldiers that accelerated to maturity in a year's time, Thrawn experimented with the cloning process by engineering the creation of the [[Grodin Tierce (clone)|Grodin Tierce clone]]; the Chiss's aim was to combine his own tactical brilliance with an excellent physical specimen. The experiment, however, resulted in the creation of an intelligent soldier rather than a leader, thus failing to meet Thrawn's expectations.<ref name="VotF" />

Thrawn's reliance on cloning also led to the creation of a [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo (clone)|clone]] based on his own genetic structure, mainly in the hopes of ensuring "his" survival in the event of his death. The clone of Thrawn was hidden within the Grand Admiral's [[Hand of Thrawn|fortress]] on [[Nirauan/Legends|Nirauan]]. The clone was engineered to reach full adulthood in ten years. During the maturation process, the clone's psychological development was facilitated through flash training and the downloaded memories of the original Thrawn.

While Thrawn conducted his war against the New Republic, the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Joruus C'baoth]], an [[Clone madness|insane clone]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Jorus C'baoth]], created a [[Luuke Skywalker|clone]] of the Jedi [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] based on cells from the right hand that Skywalker [[Cho mai/Legends|had lost]] on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] during a [[Duel on Cloud City/Legends|duel]] with Darth Vader. The Skywalker clone was grown to maturity in less than a year through Spaarti growth acceleration and was armed with [[Anakin Skywalker's second lightsaber/Legends|the lightsaber]] Skywalker had lost in that duel.<ref name="TLC" />

In addition to cloning Tierce and himself, Thrawn experimented with cloning several Force users, whose DNA had been obtained and safeguarded during Emperor Palpatine's reign. Created in secret on a [[frozen moon]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]], the Force-sensitive clones were developed and raised by Imperial scientists that served under Thrawn's [[Empire of the Hand]] until they rebelled against their creators. They remained isolated until the Jedi Knight [[Jaden Korr]] discovered the clones on the moon. Korr killed [[Alpha (clone)|Alpha]], a mentally unstable clone of [[Kam Solusar]], but the remaining clones and their children escaped from the moon. The other templates for the clones included [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]], [[Lassin]], [[Lumiya]] and other Force users that originally served the Galactic Empire.<ref name="Crosscurrent">''[[Crosscurrent]]''</ref>

====The return of the Emperor====
{{Quote|The dying is painful… the transition is not an enjoyable experience. But the suffering is a small price to pay… for eternal life.|Palpatine|<ref name="Dark Empire 2">[[Dark Empire 2|''Dark Empire'' 2]]</ref>}}
[[File:SWEE2.jpg|thumb|150px|Darth Sidious' last clone deteriorates far too quickly, leading to his final death.]]
[[10 ABY/Legends|Six years]] after the destruction of his original body, Emperor Palpatine emerged from the seclusion of Byss while the remnants of the former Empire were devastated in the ongoing [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], as well as the [[Imperial Civil War|fighting amongst Imperials]]. When Luke Skywalker infiltrated the [[Emperor's Citadel|Imperial Citadel]], he was shocked to discover that his suspicions were correct—Emperor Palpatine had survived death, in a manner of speaking. Despite the fact that Skywalker was responsible for Darth Vader's sacrificial act of redemption that led to Palpatine's first death, the Emperor still desired to turn Skywalker into his new apprentice. After revealing the unpleasant experience of constantly dying and transferring his essence into a young clone version of himself, Palpatine once more offered Skywalker a place at his side. Skywalker, like his father before him, agreed to serve the clone Emperor, believing that the only way to truly defeat Palpatine was by using the dark side against him.<ref name="DE" />

After [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and his wife [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] were captured and brought before the Emperor by Skywalker, Palpatine revealed his cloning laboratory to the wedded couple, including the numerous clone versions of himself; each one was meant to serve as his temporary vessel in turn. By then, his latest clone vessel had already deteriorated to the point where he was on the verge of dying once again. But as he prepared to transfer his soul into another host, Skywalker confirmed what Palpatine already knew—the clone Emperor's new apprentice was a double agent who sought to destroy the Galactic Empire from within and secure the survival of the New Republic—mainly by ensuring that the Emperor's next death was a permanent one.<ref name="DE" />

Skywalker attempted to deny Palpatine's soul another opportunity to avoid absolute damnation by destroying all of the clones. With his very existence on the line, the Emperor committed suicide by destroying his body, thus freeing his soul from the trappings of its decaying clone flesh. Though Skywalker proceeded to destroy all of the clones with haste, one clone survived the attack and became the Emperor's new vessel. Reborn once again as a young version of his original self, Palpatine easily defeated Skywalker in [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|combat]]. But he ultimately failed yet again to turn Skywalker to the dark side. Together with his sister, the Skywalker twins turned the clone Emperor's own dark powers against him, thus resulting in Palpatine's death once more.<ref name="DE" />

The death of the clone Emperor destabilized his Empire once again. Seeking an opportunity to seize power for themselves, treacherous subordinates destroyed Palpatine's backup supply of clone hosts in an attempt to ensure that the Emperor stayed dead for good. When the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Sedriss QL|Sedriss]] executed the traitors, the Emperor came out of hiding, thus revealing that his soul had found yet another clone to serve as his new body.<ref name="DEII">''[[Star Wars: Dark Empire II]]''</ref> But while Palpatine continued to plot against his enemies in a bid to reclaim the galaxy, he failed to notice another conspiracy that was directed to the purpose of finally ending his constant attempts to stay alive on borrowed time.<ref name="TEC">[[The Essential Chronology (real-world book)|''The Essential Chronology'']]</ref>

[[Carnor Jax]], an [[Imperial Sovereign Protector|elite member]] of the [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Royal Guard]], plotted with the Byss Clone Master to sabotage the last remaining batch of Palpatine's clones. Due to the actions of the ambitious Guardsmen and his fellow subversives, the clones suffered from an even faster rate of decay immediately after being decanted.<ref name="TEC" /> When the Emperor occupied his last clone body, it also aged rapidly in a very short time. Faced with certain death and almost no chance of returning to life ever again, the Emperor became utterly desperate to find a new way to cheat the final death that he feared so much.<ref name="EmpiresEnd">''[[Star Wars: Empire's End]]''</ref>

As his clone stood on the verge of breaking down due to its accelerated rate of decay, Palpatine traveled to [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] with the intention of inhabiting the infant body of [[Anakin Solo]], a grandson of the late Anakin Skywalker, his namesake. By then, his last clone died, thus releasing the Emperor's soul. But in his attempt to take over the young Solo's body, his essence was intercepted by the dying Jedi [[Empatojayos Brand]]. Trapped within the broken body of the very Jedi that he fatally wounded, the Emperor could do nothing but curse his enemies until Brand's death dragged Palpatine's spirit into the depths of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], forever condemning him to experience the madness of disembodiment in darkness.<ref name="EmpiresEnd" />

====Post-Palpatine period====
{{Quote|I've one of those faces that used to appear familiar to everyone.|[[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], regarding the fading memory of his [[Jango Fett/Legends|father's]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|legacy]]|<ref name="NJO:NF">''[[The New Jedi Order: The Unifying Force]]''</ref>}}
[[File:BobaFett-Fathead.png|thumb|left|180px|Boba Fett, one of few remaining clones of Jango Fett, was still active in [[44 ABY]].]]
At the time of the [[Caamas Document Crisis]], Luke Skywalker and Mara Jade discovered the hidden clone of Thrawn that was approaching maturation. Although they considered destroying the clone before he could become as much a threat as the original Thrawn, they ultimately refrained and felt that the clone should not be punished for the actions of his progenitor. However, the clone was killed during a flooding of the hidden chamber where it was located, thus preventing Thrawn's "rebirth."<ref name="VotF" />

[[Ysanne Isard]] used one of the Emperor's Spaarti cylinders to produce a [[Ysanne Isard (clone)|clone of herself]].<ref name="TNEC" /> The clone was meant to be used for a task that required the original Isard's personal supervision at a time she was otherwise indisposed. In order to guarantee that the clone operated under the belief that she was the exact same woman as her genetic donor, Isard went to great lengths to ensure that her clone remained unaware of her true status. While the original Isard ruled over [[Thyferra/Legends|Thyferra]], the clone oversaw the concealment of the ''[[Lusankya/Legends|Lusankya]]'' prisoners. Isard ordered her clone killed in the waning days of the [[Bacta War]], but the assassination attempt failed. The clone herself suffered major head trauma and had no memories of the events at Thyferra.<ref name="XW: IR">''[[X-Wing: Isard's Revenge]]''</ref>

Later, [[Grappa (Hutt)|Grappa]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], along with the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]], created a clone of [[Feena D'Asta]] in order to influence the politics of the [[Imperial Ruling Council/Legends|Imperial Ruling Council]].<ref name="CEII">''[[Star Wars: Crimson Empire II: Council of Blood]]''</ref> During the long conflicts that resulted in the Empire's fall from power throughout the galaxy, many of the Imperial cloning facilities were either captured or destroyed, thus cutting off the supply of clone soldiers that originally composed half of the Stormtrooper Corps. After being reduced to a [[Imperial Remnant|small remnant]] of their former glory, the Empire was forced to cease its reliance on clone stormtroopers by fully investing in the recruitment of enlisted stormtroopers.<ref name="SQ">''[[Survivor's Quest]]''</ref>

During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the extragalactic invaders created [[Jedi killer]] beasts known as [[voxyn]], creatures that were mass-produced through cloning. The production of the voxyn was conducted on a [[Koros-Strohna|Worldship]] in orbit around [[Myrkr/Legends|Myrkr]] until its destruction at the hands of a [[Myrkr strike team|Jedi strike team]]. The prime clone was destroyed in the process as well, thus ending the production of the voxyn clones.<ref name="SBS">''[[The New Jedi Order: Star by Star]]''</ref>

By the time of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], Kamino was virtually a faded memory of its former reputation. The once-closely guarded secrets that brought Kamino to the forefront of the science of cloning had been dispersed by defecting scientists such as [[Taun We/Legends|Taun We]]. In the aftermath of the Galactic Civil War, the Kaminoan female fled from her homeworld and became employed with Arkanian Microtechnologies where she continued her research on cloning.<ref name="Bloodlines">''[[Legacy of the Force: Bloodlines]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]'', the security check-in droid [[G2-9T/Legends|G2-9T]], upon seeing Chip and Dale in the luggage, referred to them as clones, although he claimed that their noses didn't make them perfect clones.
